name: pyfwg (Python Future Weather Generator)
summary: Python workflow manager for the Future Weather Generator CLI: batch-morphs EnergyPlus weather (EPW) files into future-climate scenarios, with parameter validation, Excel-driven parametric runs and tidy .epw/.stat output. v0.4.0 supports FWG Global 5.x, Europe 3.x and CORDEX regional distributions.

access.license: unclear: GPL-3.0 (repo LICENSE) vs MIT (README, PyPI)
access.notes: License conflict between the repo LICENSE file (GPL-3.0) and README/PyPI (MIT). Needs the separate Future Weather Generator JAR (future-weather-generator.adai.pt) with its own terms.

procedure: Download the Future Weather Generator JAR (Global, Europe or CORDEX) from future-weather-generator.adai.pt
Point pyfwg at the JAR and your EPW files; use morph_epw_global / MorphingWorkflowGlobal (docs: pyfwg.readthedocs.io)

verdict.why: Real, maintained niche tool for building-energy simulation under future climates; outside the core 3D/game focus and license is contradictory, so held.
